name: cite-nexus
description: CiteNexus connects research assistants to free scholarly metadata and optional academic APIs. Discover papers, resolve identifiers, check references, and export BibTeX, RIS or CSL-JSON with source provenance. No model or API key is required for default searches.

interface.shortDescription: Search scholarly sources, verify references, and export citations with traceable evidence.
interface.longDescription: CiteNexus connects research assistants to free scholarly metadata and optional academic APIs. Discover papers, resolve identifiers, check references, and export BibTeX, RIS or CSL-JSON with source provenance. No model or API key is required for default searches.
interface.defaultPrompt: Search free scholarly sources for my topic, retain source evidence, and verify identifiers before exporting citations.
